title: Spacious basement guest suite near airport/dwntn
description:
Newly renovated basement in-law/guest suite with private ground level access, in a very quiet but hip neighborhood called Donelson. Only 10 minutes' drive to the airport and 15 minutes' drive to downtown. 10 minute walk to the Two Rivers Greenway, Two Rivers Mansion,   Two Rivers dog park and Wave Country. Less than 5 minutes drive to Gaylord Hotel and Opry Mills mall.

The space
Newly renovated. Large and bright bedroom, living room and kitchenette plus a full bath and laundry. Over 700 square feet of private space. Huge fenced backyard. Your pets are welcome. I have 3 inside dogs who are very chill and friendly.
